## What's free

Starter: up to 6 users, 1 admin, 10 service accounts, 10 sites, unlimited clients; WireGuard-based zero-trust access

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://www.firezone.dev/pricing> before relying on this.

## Notes

REST API access (needed by Terraform) is requested in the admin portal under Settings > API Clients; confirm it is enabled for Starter before relying on the provider.

## Plan

- `stack/`: a root module that reads the hybrid inventory (`hybrid/` state) and wires every host (DNS records, mesh ACLs, tunnels)
